Sequences and inserts the full array of radial-lead components — from 2.5 mm to 10.0 mm spans, up to 22 mm tall — with a full Fuji servo drive and camera-visual programming that cuts new program setup to minutes.

Manual load or automatic PCB load/unload; In-Line or Straight-Back from 10 to 100 inputs. UIC-compatible heads, clinch bases, CTA carriers and feeders. Final configuration confirmed after technical review.

blocks.heading: When boards change every shift, programming time becomes the bottleneck

nodes.text: The hidden cost of high-mix radial insertion
When boards change every shift, programming time becomes the bottleneck
High-mix lines do not lose time only on placement — they lose it on setup. The S3010A attacks both: minutes-long programming and machine-speed insertion.
Setup eats the shift
Teaching a new board manually can take hours. In high-mix production that time is pure cost, repeated every changeover.
Polarity & value errors
Reversed capacitors and wrong-value parts slip past visual checks and fail at test — the most expensive stage to catch them.
Span diversity
Boards mix 2.5 mm and 10.0 mm span parts in the same program; machines that handle one span force manual insertion for the rest.
Tall components
Parts up to 22 mm tall get derated or handled manually on machines not built for them.
Inline integration
Connecting to loaders, unloaders and magazine racks is a project, not a plug-in, on many inserters.
Audit & traceability
Customers demand documented repeatability; manual and semi-manual steps leave gaps in the record.

blocks.heading: From manual feeding to a supervised radial insertion cell

nodes.text: S3010A Automation Solution
From manual feeding to a supervised radial insertion cell
The S3010A integrates with a PCB loader, magazine rack and unloader so boards move through the cell automatically — no operator hands between processes.
The loader automatically sends boards to the S3010A; track height and width are matched and adjustable.
The rack holds up to 50 boards; full racks feed automatically, empty racks exit for reload.
The inserter completes every board and sends it automatically to the unloader.
Finished boards enter an empty rack; at 50 boards the rack exits to the next process.
One operator manages the cell instead of several manual insertion stations.

nodes.q: What components can the S3010A insert?
nodes.a: Capacitors, transistors, LED lights, key switches and standard tape-packed radial-lead components, with spans from 2.5 mm to 10.0 mm (single, dual, triple and quad-span tooling) and components up to 22 mm tall without derating.

The camera visual operating system identifies board coordinates automatically, so an operator can finish a new PCB insertion program in under five minutes. Machine-vision coordinate correction and calibration systems keep positions accurate across boards.

nodes.q: Can it run inline with loaders and unloaders?
nodes.a: Yes. The S3010A supports automatic PCB loading and unloading with 50-board magazine racks, in In-Line or Straight-Back layouts with 10 to 100 feeder inputs. The full cell — loader, magazine rack, S3010A and unloader — is supervised by one operator.

nodes.q: Is it compatible with UIC parts?
nodes.a: Yes. The S3010A accepts UIC-compatible insertion heads, clinch bases, CTA carriers and feeders, so wearing parts are available from established supply channels. Southern Machinery also stocks spares with a 1-day lead time.
220 V AC single-phase power (50/60 Hz) and compressed air at 0.6 MPa / 0.3 m³/min. Operating temperature range is 10 °C to 35 °C.
